description: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs line 73: write!(f, "certificate {serial} is revoked (reason {code:?})") uses {:?} Debug format for CrlReason. Confirmed: x509_cert::ext::pkix::crl::CrlReason does NOT implement Display. The Debug output produces Rust variant names like 'KeyCompromise', which is marginally readable but not user-friendly. Options: (a) contribute Display impl to x509-cert upstream (preferred, fits the RustCrypto contribution workflow); (b) write a local helper fn crl_reason_name(r: CrlReason) -> &'static str mapping variants; (c) leave as-is with a comment. This is caller-visible in error messages.
title: CrlReason in Revoked Display uses Debug format instead of Display
